about: ZenEng fixes 526, 547, 548: the kept windows the judge of record is fitted on and tested against. 545 windows: CoCoPops Billboard (314) and BiMMuDa 1958-1991 (231), the first eight bars of the first verse and of the first chorus, with the judge's 39 measures of the judge of v132 (the 37, then empty_bars: bars of the eight with no onset, as a share; notes_per_bar: onsets in the window over eight). 'piece' is the song's ID, for splitting kept windows in half by piece (a song's verse and chorus go to the same half). null = the measure cannot be read on that window: BiMMuDa has no chords, so its four chord-tone measures are null by design, and a few windows lack a measure (too few leaps or moves); in the fit a null takes the median of the fitting set (the judge of record's fill_missing_with for scoring).
